texts.facts: 2. The present petition, in the nature of Public Interest Litigation, has been filed in the year 2013 to raise issues about the large scale irregularities in the public distribution system all over the State. 3. The affidavit of Under Secretary, Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs Department, State of Gujarat dated 20.09.2021 filed on behalf of the respondent No.1 indicates the rectification measures to strengthen the public distribution system in the following manner:- "6. That, as already submitted in report dated 08/01/2016, the particular district i.e. the Panchmahal district was having hundred percent barcoded ration cards and the process of biometric identification was also completed at the relevant point of time. It is respectfully submitted that from 2016 till date, there are many such upgradation in the system in form of digitalization and the steps taken are as under; 6.1 Steps taken to strengthen to check the Irregularities for fair price shop: A. That, Intensive inspections and raids are carried out by the state and District level to ensure that the beneficiaries get the quantity of goods available to them in a timely, fast and fixed quantity/price and to stop the black market. The details of the inspection are attached here with as a Annexure-RR-1 (Panchmahal Dist.) and Annexure-RR-2 (All District). B. All the PDS (public distribution system) transactions are now being done by Aadhaar based Authentication and it would automatically strengthen the security and safety and only rightful person would be benefited. Authorization at various stages of various applications or software Related to public distribution system for critical stages such as generating ration cards, splitting, issuing permits, withdrawing quantities, etc., and it be granted access Only after being authorized by Aadhaar based fingerprint is completed. D. In case of any Complaint or Grievance received in PDS, District and Taluka authorities are instructed to verify all the transactions done by particular FPS since last 2 years. Along with the transactions, the district and taluka authorities are also instructed to take survey of all the beneficiaries for their eligibility and existence of the beneficiaries. C/WPPIL/27/2013 ORDER It is respectfully submitted that by way of the steps, the state government is keen to see that the irregularities are oust. 7. That, following Steps are taken to strengthen Ration card Management system (RCMS): A. That, the state government has initiated this mission mode project with the help of state NIC in 2010. The Barcoded Ration Card for beneficiaries implemented in 2010. It is submitted that In March 2018 Gujarat government has implemented "Aadhaar based" Authentication of ration card holders for getting their entitlement through FPS. B. That, Ration Card related applications are accepted at ATVT center or on Digital Gujarat portal (Digital Seva Setu) through VCE and processed by RCMS. To achieve the accountability, up to Bottom level Aadhaar Based authentication at various key decision stages. Ration Card related all Services (New cards, Division of cards, Vinod Pandya vs State Of Gujarat - Thro Secretary Food ... on 30 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/108950184/ 3 addition/deletion of members, amendments in cards, cancellation of cards etc.) are fully Aadhaar Based Authentication. 8. That, the Steps are also taken to strengthen public distribution system (end to end Computerization) by the state government. It is further submitted that in the entire state, the beneficiaries covered under "National Food Security Act-2013" are availed essential commodities, including wheat, rice, sugar, edible oil, pulses, salt etc. at concessional rates under public distribution system through fair price shops. It is further submitted that following steps have been taken to strengthen the distribution system and to oust and minimize the irregularities in the state; A. Under "National Food Security Act-2013" in order to provide benefits to the eligible beneficiaries State Government has been doing Aadhaar seeding of Ration Cards and beneficiaries. As on 18- 09-2021, Aadhaar seeding of 99.7% ration cards and 96.0% beneficiaries has been completed. 5. The written instructions supplied by the Joint Director, Food and Civil Supplies, Gandhinagar, states that these initiatives have shown effective implementation of Public Distribution System Mechanism in a transparent manner and malpractices are minimized with the current system.
texts.arguments: Disabled/Blocked Ration Card holders will be required to apply for UIDAI-eKYC process of Aadhaar Seeding for all members by contacting the concerned Mamlatdar Office / Zonal Office to reactive the Card. This is verified by Concern DSO to reactivate the ration card. This will mostly oust and minimize chance of any irregularity." 4. Today, when the matter was taken up, Mr.Sanjay Udhwani, the learned Assistant Government Pleader appearing for the State respondent provided written instructions in compliance of the order dated 23.07.2025, to place before us that the Public Distribution System NEUTRAL CITATION C/WPPIL/27/2013 ORDER DATED: 30/07/2025 undefined Mechanism now set in place Aadhar based e-KYC based implementation, which is nationwide, village level and the Public Grievance Redressal System is set to address the issues relating to commodity, quantity, malpractices by Fair Price Shops operators and other concerns. Fair Price Shops E- Profiling is being done through biometric system, Geo- Fencing, E-FPS Web Application and GPS tracking etc. Even the mechanism of Route Optimization has been developed with software analysis and recommendations from IIT Delhi.
